entries.reason: the camera and microphone are real hardware the device has, and AVCaptureVideoDataOutput/AVCaptureAudioDataOutput's own -setSampleBufferDelegate:queue: has been on iOS 6.0 from the start; the synchronizer sits in front of it
entries.effect: initWithDataOutputs: keeps the array, the first output as master; setDelegate:queue: takes over each video or audio output's own sample buffer delegate (real API since 6.0) and, on every buffer the master output receives, delivers a single callback carrying the master's new buffer alongside the most recently received buffer of every other output in the array - an honest simplification of the real presentation-timestamp windowing the header describes, not a full re-implementation of it
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract; AVCaptureVideoDataOutput/AVCaptureAudioDataOutput's setSampleBufferDelegate:queue: and didOutputSampleBuffer:/didDropSampleBuffer: of iOS 6.1.3's own AVFoundation

entries.reason: AVCaptureDataOutputSynchronizer calls it; the protocol status is not pushed onto the class that calls it
entries.effect: dataOutputSynchronizer:didOutputSynchronizedDataCollection: is called on the delegate's queue as described

entries.reason: the abstract base every synchronized-data class carries

entries.reason: the corpus's own crash-demand row, second by exposure at 3 of 3 applications; the camera and microphone are real hardware, so there is no wall
entries.effect: sampleBuffer holds a real, CFRetained CMSampleBufferRef from AVCaptureVideoDataOutput or AVCaptureAudioDataOutput's own delegate callback, released on dealloc; sampleBufferWasDropped and droppedReason answer YES/LateData when the buffer came from didDropSampleBuffer:fromConnection: instead of didOutputSampleBuffer:fromConnection: - iOS 6's own drop callback carries no reason, so LateData is always the value given rather than the more specific reasons the header lists, a real and stated gap
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract; AVCaptureVideoDataOutput's didDropSampleBuffer:fromConnection:, present since iOS 6.0

entries.reason: carried so the class symbol resolves; AVCaptureDataOutputSynchronizer only wires up video and audio data outputs (the corpus's own demand), not AVCaptureMetadataOutput
entries.effect: metadataObjects always answers an empty array; this port's synchronizer never constructs one
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract

entries.reason: carried so the class symbol resolves; the iPhone 4S and iPad 2 this port targets have no depth-capable camera at all, a genuine hardware wall unlike the sample-buffer path above
